summary: Arbe Robotics Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a 424B5 final prospectus supplement for a registered offering of 833,334 ordinary shares at $0.60 per share and pre-funded warrants for up to 24,166,666 ordinary shares at $0.5999 per underlying share, raising roughly $15.0 million before underwriting discounts of $0.9 million. Canaccord Genuity is sole bookrunner; closing expected September 28, 2026. Warrants carry a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership blocker. Nasdaq prices referenced $0.6350 per share and $0.0046 per warrant on September 25, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
